02315fef209f0309.description: About the Role United Group is seeking a Maintenance Planner to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah. This full-time role focuses on optimizing equipment availability through effective planning and scheduling of maintenance activities, ensuring alignment with production requirements. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Maintenance Planner is responsible for developing and executing maintenance plans to maximize equipment uptime while meeting operational demands. This involves preparing various maintenance schedules, defining job scopes, and coordinating with multiple departments to ensure safe and accurate execution of planned work, with all activities recorded in SAP PM. Key Responsibilities Develop weekly and daily maintenance plans based on production requirements. Prepare preventive and predictive maintenance schedules. Prepare manpower schedules and record manpower hours. Plan corrective maintenance work orders based on priority and equipment criticality. Define job scope, manpower, tools, spare parts, materials, and estimated duration for work orders. Prioritize work orders based on safety, production impact, equipment criticality, and urgency. Coordinate maintenance activities with Production, Operations, Warehouse, and HSE departments. Coordinate spare parts and material availability in advance of planned jobs. Align planned work with production windows to minimize downtime. Close completed work orders in SAP PM. Ensure maintenance history is accurately recorded in SAP PM. Track planning performance metrics, including schedule compliance and work order backlog. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in maintenance planning or a related field. Proficiency in using SAP PM for maintenance planning and record-keeping. Strong understanding of preventive and predictive maintenance principles. Work Environment This position is based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, and operates on a full-time basis within a dynamic industrial setting. The role requires close collaboration with various operational departments to ensure seamless maintenance execution.

02b20cbc392037a3.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Network Systems & Data Security Administrator for a contract position in Jeddah, Makkah. This role involves the administration, configuration, and management of various network security, access control, endpoint, and vulnerability management systems. The administrator will ensure proper network segmentation, firewall rule optimization, secure connectivity, and compliance with hardening standards. Key Responsibilities Administer, configure, and manage Cisco Firepower Firewalls and Cisco FMC for centralized policy management. Support and maintain Palo Alto firewalls, including policy tuning, NAT, and traffic inspection. Manage Web Proxy (Broadcom Bluecoat) for secure internet access and URL filtering. Administer DDoS protection solutions (Arbor, Akamai) to ensure network resilience and availability. Configure and support F5 platforms, including APM (VPN Remote Access), ASM (Web Application Firewall), and GTM (DNS / Traffic Management). Ensure proper network segmentation, firewall rule optimization, and secure connectivity across environments. Administer Cisco ISE (AAA Server) for authentication, authorization, and accounting. Manage ForeScout NAC for device visibility and network admission control. Support OneIdentity (IAM & MFA) and Microsoft Azure MFA for secure authentication mechanisms. Administer Privileged Access Management (Delinea) to secure privileged accounts. Manage Microsoft Certificate Authority (CA) for certificate issuance, renewal, and lifecycle management. Administer Endpoint Protection platforms (Symantec Endpoint Protection, Microsoft Defender). Manage File Integrity Monitoring (ChangeTracker) for critical systems. Support secure configuration and hardening of servers, endpoints, and network devices. Administer Email Security Gateway (Symantec Messaging Gateway). Administer vulnerability management tools including Qualys and Tenable Nessus. Perform regular vulnerability scans across network, systems, and applications. Coordinate patching and remediation with infrastructure and application teams. Maintain baseline security configurations and ensure compliance with hardening standards. Support implementation of Microsoft DLP and Microsoft Purview (Data Classification) from an infrastructure integration standpoint. Administer Web Application Firewall (F5 ASM) and support application security tools (Checkmarx, SecureEyes) in coordination with development teams. Manage Database security controls (Imperva) to protect critical data assets. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum 5-10 years of experience, with 3-4 years of relevant experience in network and data security. Saudi Nationals are mandatory for this position. Hands-on experience administering multiple security tools, including: Firewalls: Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto WAF/VPN/DNS: F5 (ASM, APM, GTM) DDoS Protection: Arbor, Akamai Endpoint & Email Security: Symantec, Microsoft Defender Strong understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, switching). Ability to manage complex multi-vendor environments and troubleshoot integrations. Experience with scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python) is a plus. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to perform end-to-end administration, configuration tuning, patching, and upgrades of security platforms. Work Environment This is a 1-year contract position based in Jeddah, Makkah.

Run Generator Sets without load every weekend and report to the Power Plant Supervisor. Perform Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) for all Generator Sets, starting batteries, and control batteries. Conduct monthly PPM (W1) for each Generator set. Execute quarterly PPM (W2) for each Generator set. Perform annual PPM (W3) for each Generator set. Monitor the daily operation of fuel pumps and pre-heaters. Maintain and monitor the Engine Room. Record all readings from WH Meters for both Hospital and Housing facilities. Take hourly readings for MDB and transformer loads. Perform PPM for all electrical MDB, Switch Gear, and transformers within the Hospital & Housing Complex. Assist the Supervisor in all related tasks. Operational Accountabilities Implement departmental policies and procedures, ensuring compliance with JCI, ISO, and Aramco standards. Facilitate requirements of the Utility Management System relevant to organization-wide functions. Participate in indicator development and data collection to measure departmental performance. Conduct analysis and interpretation of collected data/information as required. Engage in hospital Safety Management & Risk Management Programs. Report incidents in the system and participate in incident review and root cause analysis when necessary. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a similar role. Proven experience within a healthcare setting is required.

028d85a6dca4da7f.description: About the Role SANY Saudi Arabia is seeking to hire two Concrete Equipment Engineers to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This is a full-time position focused on providing technical expertise and support for SANY concrete equipment. The role involves a combination of on-site work and technical documentation, ensuring the reliable operation of machinery. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support for SANY concrete equipment, including troubleshooting, maintenance, commissioning, and repair. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and control system issues. Support the installation, commissioning, and delivery of new concrete equipment. Conduct equipment inspections and preventive maintenance to ensure reliable and safe operation. Provide on-site technical support to customers and service teams. Prepare service reports, maintenance records, inspection reports, and technical documentation. Provide technical guidance and training to customers, operators, and technicians when required. Coordinate with internal technical and service teams to resolve complex equipment issues. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with SANY procedures, technical standards, and safety requirements. Travel to customer sites and project locations when required. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related Engineering field. Relevant experience with concrete machinery, construction equipment, heavy equipment, or industrial machinery is preferred. Required Skills Strong knowledge of hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, and control systems. Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and customer-service skills. Ability to work independently and effectively within a team. Work Environment and Travel This position requires a willingness to travel within Saudi Arabia as needed to support customer sites and project locations. The role involves both independent work and collaboration with internal technical and service teams. About SANY Saudi Arabia SANY Saudi Arabia is a company focused on providing heavy equipment solutions. This role is integral to supporting their concrete equipment operations and ensuring customer satisfaction through expert technical service.

029a6122e13dded0.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب أمرك سهل للخدمات الالكترونية عن مدخل بيانات للانضمام إلى فريقه في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مراجعة وتدقيق استمارات البيانات، بالإضافة إلى إدخال وتخزين المعلومات باستخدام أنظمة الحاسب الآلي. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة الاستمارات المتعلقة بالبيانات وترميزها والتأكد من اكتمالها ودقتها. إدخال البيانات والمعلومات إلى الحاسب الآلي وفقاً للبرامج والنظم الإحصائية المعتمدة. مراجعة رموز التصنيف للبيانات والمعلومات المدخلة وتصحيح أي أخطاء موجودة. تخزين المعلومات المدخلة بشكل منظم وآمن. عمل النسخ الاحتياطية اللازمة للبيانات والمعلومات المخزنة لضمان الحفاظ عليها. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بسرية البيانات والمعلومات وحمايتها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال إدخال البيانات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على مراجعة وتدقيق البيانات بدقة عالية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج إدخال البيانات وأنظمة الحاسب الآلي. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالسرية المهنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة حائل. سيتم العمل ضمن بيئة مكتبية تتطلب التركيز والدقة في التعامل مع البيانات والمعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

02acf8ffbc735c76.description: About the Role Saudi Entertainment Ventures (SEVEN) is seeking a Future Career Opportunity Attraction Supervisor for a full-time position in Jazan, Jīzān, Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing staff and overseeing attraction operations during assigned shifts, ensuring smooth and efficient functioning while upholding high standards of guest service. The supervisor is key to creating positive guest experiences by leading the team, addressing operational issues, and ensuring compliance with SEVEN's policies. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the team during assigned shifts, ensuring effective performance and adherence to SEVEN's standards. Assign tasks and responsibilities based on operational needs to ensure optimal coverage and service delivery. Provide on-the-spot training, guidance, and support to staff. Monitor and oversee all operational activities, including guest services, equipment maintenance, and safety protocols. Ensure the attraction is clean, well-maintained, and fully operational throughout the shift. Address operational issues and guest concerns promptly, escalating to the Attractions Manager when necessary. Ensure all guests receive high-quality service, focusing on creating a positive and memorable experience. Handle guest inquiries, complaints, and feedback professionally, taking appropriate actions to resolve issues. Promote a culture of guest service excellence among staff. Enforce safety protocols and ensure adherence to SEVEN's safety standards and procedures. Conduct regular checks of equipment and facilities for potential safety hazards or maintenance needs. Ensure all shift activities comply with local regulations and internal policies. Maintain accurate records of shift activities, including staff attendance, guest interactions, and incidents. Prepare shift reports for the Attractions Manager, highlighting operational outcomes, challenges, and recommendations. Ensure all documentation is completed accurately and submitted in a timely manner. Adhere to Service Level Standards (SLS). Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Working Relationships The Future Career Opportunity Attraction Supervisor will interact internally with the Attractions Manager, Operations Team, Maintenance Team, and Guest Services Team. External interactions will include guests and vendors for equipment and supplies. Physical Requirements Candidates must have the ability to work independently, perform manual handling tasks, lift up to 5kg, stand for extended periods, bend, reach, push/pull up to 10kg, with full mobility and no visual or auditory impediments.

02c0d768346d8f09.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن مهندس تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتصميم والإشراف على أنظمة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، مع ضمان الأداء والجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم معدات وأنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء، وتحديد معايير الأداء والجودة المطلوبة. إدارة عمليات تركيب المعدات والأنظمة، بما في ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تنفيذ برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال هندسة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم عميق لمبادئ تصميم وتشغيل وصيانة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق الهندسية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الظهران، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

02c52645c1e13e34.description: About the Role Aqarat Real Estate Development Company is seeking a Photographer & Visual Content Producer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves capturing and producing professional visual content for land and real estate projects and assets, ensuring their features and benefits are accurately and attractively showcased to support marketing campaigns and presentations. Role Purpose The Photographer & Visual Content Producer is responsible for creating high-quality visual materials that align with the company's approved visual identity. The content will be used for marketing campaigns, customer presentations, and investor communications, highlighting the actual condition and unique aspects of real estate properties and projects. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute photography and video shoots for land, real estate projects, and assets, coordinating with relevant internal teams. Capture sites from optimal angles to highlight their features and surroundings, ensuring content accurately reflects their actual condition. Produce and edit photos and videos for advertisements, digital platforms, presentations, and events. Develop visual stories and short videos that emphasize the benefits of each real estate asset, aligning with campaign objectives and target audiences. Coordinate with the marketing team to understand content requirements, key messages, and delivery deadlines. Incorporate visual elements, text, and simple graphics into content as needed, adhering to the approved visual identity guidelines. Review visual materials for quality and accuracy before publication, submitting them for approval according to established procedures. Organize and maintain the photo and video archive, categorizing files by project or asset and shoot date, retaining both original and final versions. Manage and maintain photography, lighting, and audio equipment, and identify technical requirements for shoots. Coordinate with external suppliers or photographers when necessary and assess the quality of their deliverables. Qualifications and Experience Education: A Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Photography, Visual Production, Media, or a related field is required. Experience: A minimum of 3 years of experience in photography and visual content production and editing is essential. Experience in real estate and project photography is preferred. Portfolio: Candidates must provide a portfolio showcasing previous work. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

02e4a4c6230feb95.description: About the Role Al Safi Danone is seeking a Maintenance Technician to join their team in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for maintaining filling, packaging, and dairy process equipment through effective preventive and corrective maintenance activities. The position focuses on ensuring operational performance and equipment availability across manufacturing operations. Key Responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on filling, packaging, and dairy process equipment. Diagnose equipment faults and execute necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments. Ensure equipment reliability and minimize downtime through effective maintenance practices. Identify root causes of equipment failures and implement corrective actions. Support production teams in resolving technical issues affecting operations. Execute maintenance work orders according to schedules and priorities. Monitor equipment performance and contribute to improving operational efficiency. Safety and Compliance Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by strictly following safety standards, procedures, and site regulations. Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational policies at all times. Troubleshooting and Improvement Assist in improving equipment performance and reliability through effective troubleshooting techniques. Identify opportunities to enhance maintenance processes and equipment performance. Support initiatives that improve operational efficiency, equipment reliability, and cost control. Contribute to continuous improvement programs within the maintenance department. Resource Management Ensure proper utilization of maintenance tools, materials, and resources. Support spare parts monitoring and report shortages as required. Assist in maintaining accurate maintenance records and documentation. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant maintenance role. Proven ability to perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for equipment failures.

02ed7e3d8379be16.description: About Sheraton and the Role Sheraton, a brand within Marriott International, is seeking a General Cashier & Paymaster to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position is open to Saudi nationals only and requires 0-1 years of experience. The role involves managing financial records and cash operations, contributing to the brand's mission of creating a sense of belonging for guests worldwide. Key Responsibilities Verify figures, postings, and documents for accuracy and proper coding. Organize, secure, and maintain all financial files, records, cash, and cash equivalents according to established policies. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data for record-keeping using various tools. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as required. Conduct periodic audits of cashier banks in line with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Manage the maintenance, distribution, and recording of petty cash, cashier banks, and contracts. Document, maintain, communicate, and address all cash variances according to SOPs. Serve as a liaison between the property and armored car services or primary banking institutions. Participate in internal, external, and regulatory audit processes, ensuring compliance with SOPs. General Duties and Professional Conduct Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Maintain a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Ensure the confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Safeguard the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Communicate clearly and professionally with others. Prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Foster positive working relationships and support team goals. Listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Perform physical tasks such as moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. Execute other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school diploma or *** equivalent. Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required for this role. License or Certification: None specified. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a global community, emphasizing teamwork and a commitment to delivering meaningful guest experiences.

02bbea121773b32e.description: Adree is seeking a highly technical and collaborative OutSystems Developer, Senior Tech Lead to design, build, and oversee the delivery of enterprise-grade digital solutions. This role serves as the ultimate technical authority for OutSystems implementations, guiding the development team on best practices, architecture patterns, and integration strategies. The Tech Lead will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring scalable, secure, and high-performance applications that align with architectural standards and organizational goals. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of OutSystems developers, conducting code reviews, establishing development standards, and ensuring best practices are followed. Architecture & Design: Design scalable, secure, and maintainable OutSystems applications (Reactive Web and Mobile) based on OutSystems 4-Layer Architecture principles. Integration Management: Architect and implement complex integrations with external systems, databases, APIs (REST/SOAP), and enterprise platforms (e.g., Creatio CRM, .NET backends). Delivery & Code Quality: Oversee the technical delivery of projects, ensuring code quality, performance optimization, and proper deployment (CI/CD) pipelines within OutSystems Service Studio and Lifetime. Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and UI/UX designers to translate requirements into technical specifications and estimate development efforts. Troubleshooting & Support: Resolve complex technical blockers, performance bottlenecks, and critical production issues across environments. Governance & Security: Implement strict security standards (Access Control, Data Encryption, OWASP top 10 mitigation) within the OutSystems ecosystem. Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Experience 6+ years of experience in software development, with at least 4+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in building enterprise applications using the OutSystems platform. Proven experience leading technical teams or acting as a Tech Lead/Architect in an Agile environment. Skills & Competencies (Technical & Analytical + Soft) Expert OutSystems Proficiency: Deep knowledge of OutSystems Service Studio, Integration Studio, Service Center, and LifeTime. Architecture Mastery: Expert understanding of OutSystems architecture patterns, refactoring, and database modeling. Technical Ecosystem: Strong proficiency in SQL Server/Oracle database design, stored procedures, and optimization. Good grasp of .NET (C#) for creating custom extensions. Agile Core: Solid understanding of Scrum methodologies, working comfortably with Jira and Confluence. Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to diagnose infrastructure, performance, or integration issues. Leadership & Communication: Strong mentorship skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Job Location: HQ

0248be6b4ec6a4b0.description: Role Summary The Admin Specialist is responsible for providing comprehensive administrative and office support to the project team. This role ensures efficient document management, coordination of meetings, office administration, correspondence handling, and support for daily operational activities. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced project environment. Key Responsibilities Manage daily administrative and office operations. Maintain and organize project documentation, records, and filing systems. Coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, and record meeting minutes. Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence, emails, and phone communications. Support document control processes and ensure proper document distribution. Arrange travel, accommodation, and logistics for project staff when required. Monitor office supplies and coordinate procurement requests. Assist in preparing reports, presentations, and other project-related documents. Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth operations. Ensure compliance with company policies and administrative procedures. Support onboarding activities for new employees and project personnel. Perform other administrative duties assigned by management. Requirements Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Management, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in administration, office management, or a similar role. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Excellent communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information professionally. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities. Experience working in project, construction, engineering, or consultancy environments is preferred. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.

028ac8dd7b3e4eb3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة خارطة الانماء للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني والإشراف على تنفيذها، مع التركيز على الجودة والدقة الهندسية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومناسبة للمهندسين ذوي الخبرة الحديثة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والرسومات المعمارية. معرفة جيدة بمواد البناء ومواصفاتها. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة خارطة الانماء للاستشارات الهندسية في مدينة الدمام. يتطلب الدور التواجد بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة، مع إمكانية الإشراف على المشاريع في المواقع المختلفة بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للمهندسين المعماريين الطموحين لاكتساب خبرة عملية قيمة والمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية متنوعة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.

0201637512f7ce5f.description: About the Role NES Global Talent is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join one of the leading companies in Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for an experienced professional in the Oil & Gas industry. Role Overview The Senior Mechanical Engineer will contribute to engineering and design projects within the Oil & Gas sector. The role requires a strong background in engineering and design, with specific experience in Project Management Consultancy (PMC). Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 15 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry. Strong background in engineering and design. 0227d8deea8de260.description: About the Role Datamatics Technologies is seeking an experienced Database Administrator (DBA) to manage and support enterprise database environments. This is a full-time position for a professional with 2-5 years of hands-on experience in database administration. Role Overview The Database Administrator will be responsible for the comprehensive administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of various database systems. This role requires strong technical expertise in managing critical database infrastructure to ensure performance, availability, and security. Key Responsibilities Perform standard DBA activities including database administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain database systems. Manage database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery activities. Monitor database performance, availability, capacity, and health. Perform SQL and database performance tuning. Manage users, roles, permissions, and database security. Troubleshoot and resolve database-related incidents and performance issues. Support database migrations, upgrades, and maintenance activities. Ensure data integrity, availability, and reliability. Maintain database documentation, procedures, and configurations. Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and development teams on database-related requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience 3-5 years of hands-on experience managing and supporting enterprise database environments. Strong experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and/or MySQL.
